cues.text: In an abandoned military base deep underground, you and the team walk in among concrete walls and steel girders and spread out to look around.
At the voice behind you, everyone spins around and drops into a fighting stance.
Two young men walk out from the back of the room toward you: a pale one with long hair, and one in glasses carrying a metal case.
Takaya turns his back on you and walks away. Jin follows him, grinning back over his shoulder.
A gate slams shut between you and them. Akihiko runs to it, too late, as Jin strolls off on the other side.
